summary: Iter230 — Full E2E of 4 features (Sezioni Più Chiare, Freezer nel Piano AI, Tour Guidato Sitor, Semaforo Celle Live). Backend + Frontend PASS. 5/5 pytest cases green (autoplan accepts machines+freezer_stock and reflects 120 semilavorate in plan; autoplan/options accepts freezer_stock; /api/lab/sensors GET/POST). Frontend: all 5 capo-group-hint-{piano,ordini,squadra,strumenti,sitor} render; Sitor Tour auto-shows with 6 dots, next/mute/finish work and set mikilab_sitor_tour_done; header sitor-tour-open relaunches tour; autoplan-freezer-note visible when freezer stock exists; Cold Chain cold-legend + 10 status dots render (all grey w/ 'No sensor' — expected: current dept catalog has no freezer-type cells, so warm sensor does not visibly flip a cell red — see note).

issues: Current dept catalog contains cell types Proofing/Cold retard/Fridge/Maturation/Drying/Cell/Chilled display/Hot display but NO 'freezer' type cell — so a warm /api/lab/sensors type:'freezer' reading has no visible target cell to turn red. Live semaphore code works, but this end-to-end 'red on warm' scenario is not visible in the UI until a freezer-type cell is added to the dept catalog (or the mapping treats 'Cold retard'/'Fridge' as freezer-adjacent).

Test browser default is EN so all copy renders in English (e.g. 'Cells & Freezer · Cold Chain', 'Sitor considers 1 freezer items: frozen stock used first.'). Not a bug — tri() is bilingual — but confirms Italian is only shown when app lang=IT.

action_items: Consider adding at least one cell of type 'freezer' per department in the dept catalog so cold-cell-status-* can visibly render red/yellow/green from real /lab/sensors freezer readings (otherwise the semaphore stays permanently grey for real bakeries with only proofing/fridge cells).
Optionally: micro-copy — 'considers 1 freezer items' → 'considers 1 freezer item' (pluralisation) in English tri() branch.
critical_code_review_comments: AutoPlanReq.machines is List[str] (validated by backend 422 on object payload) — frontend correctly sends selMach (array of names). Test note documented.
AutoPlan.jsx line 74: `freezer.length > 0` gate is correct. GET /api/freezer returns items as-is including dept — verified persistence.

ColdStorage cellStatus() correctly defaults to grey 'No sensor' when no sensor readings match — but the dept catalog lacks a freezer-type cell, so the red-on-warm scenario is not observable end-to-end. Consider seeding at least one freezer cell per dept.
seed_data_creation: TEST_baguette_semi freezer item + TEST_t1 freezer sensor reading created for verification. Freezer items cleaned back to empty. TEST_t1 sensor reading kept (no delete endpoint) — non-fatal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tour flow works and sets mikilab_sitor_tour_done. To retest tour, remove that key. To retest freezer note, PUT /api/freezer items with at least one row and reload. To see red semaphore, need a freezer-type cell in dept catalog; presently only grey observed. Console shows benign 401s on initial fetches before gate cookie is set — not an app bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four features verified functionally. The only advisory is a catalog gap (no freezer-type cells), which prevents observation of red status in Cold Chain semaphore even though code path is present.
